text: The paper reports that for label 0 the computed pseudolabel-correction bound is below the teacher error alpha_0 and correction does occur (err(f, y|S_0) < alpha_0), while for label 1 the bound exceeds alpha_1, because measured expansion is lower and weak-label error higher, and no correction occurs. For coverage expansion on label 1, T_1 expands to both S_1^good (c = 0.75) and S_1^bad (c = 0.55), and the worst-case student error on T_1 over training runs is 0.29 against a bound value of 0.33.
title: Measured expansion predicts pseudolabel correction and coverage expansion on IMDb
